design: A: database triggers refuse UPDATE of terminal quant_jobs rows, every DELETE on quant_jobs, INSERT of steps, foundation links and chunks for terminal parents, and chunk DELETE or UPDATE for terminal parents except clearing unit_name/unit_token; SECURITY INVOKER, public-qualified relations, search_path pinned to pg_catalog,pg_temp, FOR SHARE parent lookup, ENABLE ALWAYS, SQLSTATE QR001, marker function quant_research_freeze_version(); no table or grants change; pure-DROP rollback; library reports DB_TRIGGER only when the marker and all guards are present and enabled always.

process.findings: F1 high pg_temp shadowing; F2-F4 medium; F5-F7 low

process.step: Root confirmation of F1 and F2 against source

independent.freeze: 13/13 with restart and dump/restore not skipped

unrelatedFailures.detail: ECONNREFUSED on a loopback port only in the shared-process whole-suite run; passes 4/4 alone

One statement timeout in the whole run; one report-privacy assertion fails alone, likely because the verifier connection user name postgres appears in the report. The file imports only db.js and the D6 harness, neither changed by this candidate; a baseline run without the candidate was not made.

ownerDecisions: D1 approve design A; refuse every DELETE (candidate default) or only terminal rows
D2 add REVOKE DELETE and TRUNCATE checks in a later grants window
D3 whether a live negative write probe may run on staging or only on a restore rehearsal
D4 whether the append-only seal table is required before QR-2
stagingGates: Per-effect owner GO, one operations worker, known host health and job plan, no overlap with R7B/EM2
Backup and cold archive with writers stopped under the maintenance lock
Staging catalog read of TEMP privilege and parameter ACLs

findings.detail: Pre-existing quant_research_mode_guard and quant_research_mode_change in quant-research-foundation-schema.sql use unqualified relations without a pinned search_path, so a runtime-role TEMP table could shadow them; not changed here; needs its own packet.
The foundation claim UPDATE (quant-research-foundation.js:161) has no status filter; the invariant holds by reading, but a violation would now raise inside the claim.
quant-research-http-fixture does not install the freeze, so its suites do not exercise it.

limits: Local throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 only; nothing committed, deployed or migrated on staging.
The schema owner can still disable triggers; pre-install edits are caught only by read-time checks.
Not wired into package.json or service start.

followUps.summary: Freeze migration now classifies before writing and refuses unknown states; all guard CLIs gain a read-only --inspect. Earlier hashes for the freeze migration, CLI and test are superseded. Whole-suite runs must leave the restart-test variables unset.

A whole serial run found one intermittent failure of the A4 cancellation test, caused by a pre-existing race between the cancel request and the worker heartbeat, not by the freeze or the guards; the test now retries only the documented 409 RETRY_TRANSACTION answer. Supersedes the earlier hash of the prepare test.
